app.name: CleanYourMail
app.title: CleanYourMail
app.window_title: CleanYourMail — Your inbox, without the noise.
app.privacy: Local by default. Opt-in feedback only. No telemetry.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.body: Share an idea or report a bug. Nothing is sent automatically: there is no telemetry or analytics.
feedback.message_placeholder: What happened, or what would you change?
feedback.checklist_help: This checklist is the only extra information attached. Remove anything you do not want to send. Do not include passwords, tokens, email addresses, subjects or message IDs.
feedback.contact_placeholder: Discord, GitHub or email, if you want a reply
feedback.consent: I agree to send this text to the CleanYourMail Discord.
feedback.sent: Thank you. Your feedback was sent.
feedback.empty: Write a message or keep at least one checklist line.
feedback.consent_required: Tick the consent box before sending.
feedback.invalid: Check the feedback fields and try again.
feedback.message_too_long: The message is too long. Keep it under 2800 characters.
feedback.checklist_too_long: The checklist is too long. Keep it under 2500 characters.
feedback.contact_too_long: The contact is too long. Keep it under 200 characters.
feedback.not_configured: Feedback is not available in this build.
feedback.rate_limited: Too many reports were sent from this connection. Try again in a few minutes.
feedback.failed: The feedback could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

provider.title: Which email provider do you use?
provider.subtitle: Pick the service that hosts your mailbox. We will guide the connection; you never type your normal password.

email.label: Email address
email.help: We only use this to match your provider and connect. It stays on this computer.
email.invalid: Enter a complete email address, like you@example.com.

status.partial_detail: Works with limits. Read the note before you connect.
status.documented_detail: Follows the provider's documentation; not smoke-tested yet.

outlook.label: Outlook / Microsoft 365
outlook.note: Microsoft 365 needs admin consent; Outlook.com personal needs a verified publisher.

custom.label: Custom IMAP
custom.note: Host only. This build always uses port 993 with TLS.

connect.title: Connect your mailbox
connect.subtitle: CleanYourMail never asks for your normal password and never stores one in its settings.

app_password.label: App password
app_password.help: Paste the app password from your provider, not your account password.
app_password.invalid: An app password is 16 characters. Remove the spaces and check it again.
app_password.saved: Saved. The field is now cleared.
app_password.cleared: The password is cleared as soon as it is saved.

gmail.title: Gmail uses an App Password
gmail.intro: Google blocks normal passwords for mail apps. Create an App Password instead.
gmail.step_1: Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google Account.
gmail.step_2: Open App Passwords and create a password for “Mail”.
gmail.step_3: Paste the 16-character password here and save.
gmail.two_factor_missing: If you do not see App Passwords, 2-Step Verification is still off.

outlook.title: Connect with Microsoft
outlook.intro: Microsoft shows a code on this screen. You approve it in your browser; the app never sees your Microsoft password.
outlook.waiting: Waiting for approval in your browser…
outlook.cancelled: The sign-in was cancelled in CleanYourMail. If it was already approved at Microsoft, the helper may finish in the background, but this app will not use that result.
outlook.expired: The Microsoft sign-in expired, was declined or was revoked. Start the sign-in again.
outlook.failed: Microsoft sign-in did not finish. Start it again, or check the provider help.

blocked.title: Microsoft blocked the sign-in
blocked.body: Microsoft 365 accounts need a tenant administrator to approve this app. Outlook.com personal accounts need a verified publisher. CleanYourMail cannot bypass either rule.
blocked.help: Ask your administrator, or use a custom IMAP connection if your organization allows it.

yahoo.title: Yahoo uses an App Password
yahoo.intro: Create an app password in Yahoo Account Security, then paste it here.

icloud.title: iCloud uses an App Password
icloud.intro: Create an app password at Apple ID, then paste it here. Your Apple ID password will not work.

fastmail.title: Fastmail uses an App Password
fastmail.intro: Create an app password in Fastmail settings, then paste it here.

proton.title: Proton Bridge must be running
proton.intro: Start Proton Bridge on this computer and use the Bridge password it shows, not your Proton password.

custom.title: Custom IMAP
custom.intro: Enter the IMAP host your provider gave you. CleanYourMail 1.3.0 always connects on port 993 with TLS; another port or STARTTLS needs a later sidecar release.
custom.fixed_port_tls: Port 993 with TLS only. If your provider uses another port or STARTTLS, this build cannot connect yet.
custom.password_help: Use the IMAP password for this account. It is stored only in the private password file and is never passed on the command line.

doctor.hint: Check the address, the app password and your provider's IMAP setting.

connect.secret_note: The app password is saved in a local file only you can read. It is never logged or shown again.

bridge.password_help: Use the Bridge password Proton Bridge shows. It is stored only in the private password file and is never passed on the command line.

replace.title: Replace the existing connection?
replace.body: This config already belongs to {email}. Saving this account would replace that connection and its password. Replace it?

preferences.title: What should we clean?
preferences.subtitle: These choices become the safety rules for this run. Nothing moves until you review the plan.

newsletter.label: Newsletters
newsletter.help: Recurring bulk mail you did not ask for.

spam.label: Spam
spam.help: Moved to Junk only. Never unsubscribed.

mode.title: How to clean
mode.folders_help: Reversible: each category gets its own folder.
mode.archive_help: Removes the Inbox label. Gmail only.

protect.title: Protect
protect.help: Protected mail is never moved, even if it matches a category.

limits.title: Limits
limits.out_of_range: Check the limits: age 0–3650 days, moves and groups 1–5000.
limits.help: Small runs are easier to check and undo.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.help: The app writes the config for you. You never edit it by hand.

preferences.spam_note: Spam always goes to Junk and is never unsubscribed.

review.title: Review before anything changes
review.subtitle: This is a dry run. Nothing has moved yet.

scan.title: Step 1 · Scan your mailbox
scan.body: We read only the sender, the subject and the date. We do not open messages or move anything.
scan.result: We found {messages} messages in {categories} categories. Nothing has been changed.

report.title: Step 2 · See what we found
report.body: This summary is informative only. Protected messages will not be touched.
report.result: We found {messages} messages in {groups} sender groups; {protected} are protected.

plan.title: Step 3 · Review the plan
plan.body: This is exactly what will move if you apply. Nothing moves until you press Apply.

plan.title: Plan
plan.done: Plan ready. Nothing has changed yet.
plan.protected_note: Protected messages are excluded from this plan.

review.reviewed: I have reviewed the plan and understand what it changes.

undo.title: Undo
undo.body: Every run writes a journal. Undo restores messages only after checking their identity.
undo.confirm: Undo the last run and restore its messages?
undo.confirm_run: Undo run {run} and restore its messages?
undo.partial: Some messages could not be restored: {failed} missing and {refused} refused.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
unsubscribe.warning: Unsubscribe asks the sender's server to remove you. It cannot be undone.
unsubscribe.manual_note: Some senders only offer a manual link.
unsubscribe.unavailable: Unsubscribe is not available in this build. Apply only moves messages and never sends an unsubscribe request.

apply.title: Applying your plan
apply.failed_undo: You can undo the messages that were already moved.
apply.partial: Some messages were skipped. The messages that were moved are journaled and can be undone.
apply.confirm: Apply this plan and move up to {count} messages? You can undo the run afterwards.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: The app could not finish that step.
errors.cli_missing: The CleanYourMail helper is missing. Reinstall the app.
errors.config: The configuration could not be read or written.
errors.connection: Could not reach the mail server.
errors.auth: The server rejected the sign-in. Check the app password or approve the sign-in again.
errors.doctor: The connection test did not pass.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer.
errors.oauth_blocked: Microsoft blocked the sign-in. See the Outlook note.
errors.secret_write: The app password could not be saved. Check that your user profile is writable.
errors.scan: The mailbox could not be scanned. Check the connection and try again.
errors.report: The report could not be built. Run a scan first.
errors.plan: The plan could not be built. Run a scan and a report first.
errors.apply: The plan could not be applied. Check the connection and try again.
errors.journal: The journal could not be read.
errors.undo: The run could not be undone. Check the connection and try again.
errors.cli_version: The CleanYourMail helper is not version 1.3.0. Reinstall the app with its bundled helper.
errors.unsafe_url: Only secure https:// links can be opened.
errors.settings_write: The app could not save your account settings. Check that your user profile is writable.

installer.no_admin: Installs for this user only. No administrator rights needed.

smartscreen.title: Windows may warn you
smartscreen.body: This build is not code-signed yet. Choose “More info” and then “Run anyway” only if you downloaded it from the official release page.
smartscreen.verify: Verify the SHA-256 of the installer before you run it.

installer.data_kept: Uninstalling removes the app files only. Your settings and local secrets stay on this computer.
